تقاطعت (form VI)
# تَقَاطَعْتُ (taqāṭaʕtu) /ta.qaː.tˤaʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَاطَعَ (taqāṭaʕa)
# تَقَاطَعْتَ (taqāṭaʕta) /ta.qaː.tˤaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَاطَعَ (taqāṭaʕa)
# تَقَاطَعْتِ (taqāṭaʕti) /ta.qaː.tˤaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَاطَعَ (taqāṭaʕa)
# تَقَاطَعَتْ (taqāṭaʕat) /ta.qaː.tˤa.ʕat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
